snippet.title: IShowSpeed Performed at the World Cup Final, Then Watched Messi Lose | The Full Story
snippet.description:
IShowSpeed performed at the closing ceremony of the 2026 World Cup Final in New York New Jersey, then streamed the whole final, Argentina vs Spain, live from the stadium.

His dad rode a Greyhound bus for twelve hours to watch him perform after his flight was cancelled. Speed was so nervous he could not feel his legs. Then the night kept getting bigger: Mike Tyson, Tracy Morgan, a $10,000 bet offer from MrBeast, a red card in the 90th minute, extra time, and meeting BTS seconds before Spain scored. For the biggest Ronaldo fan on the internet, it ended with one line: "I am saved." This is the six-hour livestream told as one story in about 10 minutes.

Would you have taken MrBeast's bet?
